No. The release invariants make `is.waiwai.dictation` permanent because existing Accessibility grants depend on it. Changing it would drop those grants for every installed copy, and Sparkle won't apply updates across a bundle ID change.

You can rename the app to OpenRamble without touching the ID. Change the display name (`CFBundleName` / `CFBundleDisplayName`) and product name. Users would see the new name and keep their permissions.

If you still want a new identifier, the invariant in the rules file has to change first. That's your call. I'd keep the ID and rename the display name.

I haven't checked the current Info.plist or release docs in this session because I have no file access here. This answer relies on the rules file and how Sparkle works.
